name: Compass
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level ranger 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range personal
Effect one blue compass arrow
Duration 10 minutes
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

A blue arrow appears in the palm of your hand. For the duration of the spell, the arrow will always point north.
